propositions: A durable append-only NDJSON snapshot store is needed to persist point-in-time code-health metrics (coverage, complexity, clone count) so their movement over time can be tracked.

Snapshot records must be written to and read from `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson`, a git-tracked path under `.rebar/` rather than the gitignored `reports/` directory, to ensure trend history persists across CI runs.
The `.gitignore` file must include a negation rule `!.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` to un-ignore the snapshot store file so it is committed despite the blanket `.rebar/*` ignore rule.
The `read_snapshots(since, until)` function must filter records by date range and skip malformed or truncated NDJSON lines without raising exceptions, returning only valid records.
Unit tests must verify round-trip write/read, range filtering, and resilience to corrupt lines while confirming the snapshot store path is not matched by `.gitignore`.
